displayDescription: A terracotta idea lands, extrudes into a core and links four sage modules on true isometric axes in a low-key cutaway.
styleRenderer: Three.js WebGLRenderer (local three 0.186.1, bundled with local esbuild into scene.js)
Three.js OrthographicCamera at true isometric orientation (camera on the (1,1,1) diagonal)
SVG + HTML/CSS screen-aligned 2D label and copy layer
chroma.js palette normalisation and contrast assessment
motionEngine: GSAP paused timeline built in an inline script in index.html and registered at window.__timelines["video"]; it is the sole owner of the scene state object, text opacity/offset and leader stroke-dashoffset. scene.js (Three.js) exposes draw(), which redraws WebGL from that state on timeline update, seek (wrapped totalTime) and hf-seek.
audioDescription: Silent preview. No soundtrack, effects or voice were created.
limitations: Blender was not used, per the user's instruction; the scene is a procedural Three.js approximation of flat isometric illustration.
Lighting is not simulated: faces use fixed flat tonal steps (top/left/right) mixed toward the ink token, and cast shadows are flat offset quads, not computed shadows.
The warm floor pool is an additive canvas-gradient texture, not real emissive light; module windows and link tops change fill colour rather than glow.
WebGL line outlines render at 1 px.
Background is a scene-dependent dark slate void chosen from the source-frame review instead of the #F3EFE5 example swatch; sage #6E9990 and terracotta #C98961 keep their approved semantic roles.
STYLE.json contains no tech.preview_recipes, so no specific recipe is demonstrated; the refresh applies the BACKGROUND_REVIEW lessons.
Not rendered or browser-tested by the agent after this repair; host QA is pending.
